Name: Granny Eun's Vanilla Portraits
Author: GrannyEun
Description:
This mod features a new look for all SV character portraits, including their beach and winter portraits! These portraits are a bit stylized and feature a semi-realistic look. I hope you all enjoy!

5/18/2024 I have added a version of this mod for those who play with Stardew Valley Expanded. It ensures that Gunther, Morris, and Marlon function as intended. Let me know if anyone runs into issues. If you plan on using my SVE portraits, please ensure you've downloaded the appropriate version of my vanilla portraits.

6/11/2024 Portraiture is LIVE! This should make things so much easier for many of you, hopefully. This version obviously requires Portraiture, hence why I added it to the requirements. It does not require, PyTK Lite, however! Works awesome without it!

How to Install:﻿[/u]

[font=Arial]Portraiture Version (Recommended):

Navigate to your "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" folder. Drag and drop the "GrannyEun" folder into the Portraits folder. Launch your game using SMAPI. When in a dialogue conversation, press the "p" button to change the portrait.

Content Patcher Version:

Drag and drop the folder [CP] Granny Eun's Vanilla Portraits wherever you have your Mods folder located. My mods folder looks like this: C:\Program Files
(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods.

I recommend using PyTK Lite, I have not tested this mod with the original PyTK.
